description: Spec §7.2: the player's car is granted a Gun (its roof shows SM_DF_RoofGun, and the car's Weapon is seen to fire from RoofWeapon: its VisualOrigin) and fires once. In the frame of the shot (the muzzle flash lives 0.06 s and the tracer 0.08 s; a headless frame is about 0.33 s) exactly one BP_DFFxTracer and one BP_DFFxMuzzle stand within 15 m of the car, and the tracer starts within 30 cm of RoofWeapon's Muzzle socket.
